scenario_matches.rationale: No candidate establishes blank required fields, validation messaging, or remaining on the login form.
Covers credential entry and a normal submit path, but does not preserve the token-claim fallback or disabled-loading assertion.
An exception submit is represented, but HTTP detail/default and network-reject variants with login-form recovery are not explicit.
The candidate submits credentials and selects a project, preserving the main transition, though automatic retrieval and context-header semantics are not observable.
No candidate covers an empty project response or prevention of project selection.
Combined exception and normal candidates cover project-list refresh failure and retry under idle retrieval preconditions.
Covers project-page logout returning to the login form; auth removal is not directly observable but route semantics match.
Task selection is covered, but automatic first-task bootstrap and replacement of task data are not preserved.
Covers creating a new task from the project shell, though the empty-list guidance and resulting upload bootstrap are not explicit.
Combined task-selection and task-creation exception branches preserve task API failure outcomes, but message-card and bootstrap details are not shown.
Covers stage navigation, home/upload routing, and settings, but does not explicitly prove disabled future navigation or refresh behavior.
Covers shell logout and return to the login-form page with recovery role semantics.
Combined file selection, upload/parsing, completion, and transition to parsed database preserve the normal document-parsing route.
Upload/parsing is covered, but the required no-task precondition and task creation/bootstrap handoff are absent.
Covers reset of completed upload and clearing a selected file, preserving the replacement/cancel behavior at a static level.
The failure branch explicitly preserves upload/parsing failure and recovery feasibility, though individual encoding, background, and polling-error variants are grouped.
No candidate has a locked post-generation upload precondition or verifies that re-upload controls are unavailable.
A parsed-database view/page change is covered, but the four tabs, search, pagination, and overview diagnostics assertions are missing.
No candidate covers empty parsed-data results or partial overview/diagnostics information.
No candidate covers parsed-list API errors, loading recovery, or stale-request protection.
Combined candidates cover parsed-to-upload back navigation, parsed-to-business entry, and business previous-stage return.
The combined selection candidates cover context/category select-all, clear, individual select/deselect, and recovery direction; diagnostics/filter and count details remain runtime-unverified.
No candidate covers empty flow/category panels or diagnostics failure with generation disabled.
Covers opening business-flow text, but modal content variants and close/backdrop dismissal are not explicit.
No candidate covers missing or failed flow text and the resulting unavailable-data message.
Covers requesting preset scenario/test-case output on a selected business page, but not progress polling, completion matrix, or modal close.
No candidate represents an already-active same-flow preset run being resumed without a new request.
Only a generic preset exception is represented; conflict, failed progress/API variants, and safe early modal close are missing.
Covers selected-flow generation and transition to the scenario page, but the no-selection disabled branch is absent.
No candidate has an active generation precondition with no new POST and transition to existing scenario progress.
Covers generation-request exception and recovery semantics, though specific progress/request/unknown-flow failures are not distinguished.
Combined normal and exception CSV-export candidates preserve the business-page export success/failure branches and idle-generation guard.
Scenario-page entry and return are present, but automatic/manual progress tracking, run history, and result-confirmation behavior are not.
No candidate covers failed or partially failed generation evidence, judgement history, or corrective actions.
No candidate covers result filters, search, expansion, or empty-detail rendering.
No candidate covers paginated result navigation or preserving stale rows after page failure.
Combined scenario CSV normal and exception branches preserve download intent and failure recovery, though file content/button details are runtime-unverified.
Combined Excel normal and exception branches preserve download intent and recovery semantics; workbook content assertions are not directly evidenced.
Explicitly covers navigation back from scenario to the business stage.
Covers home/product-style routing to upload from the main shell, though same-task/session preservation is not explicit.
Only the BUSINESS previous-stage return is covered; both business-list pagination branches are absent.
No candidate covers scenario initial/refresh Promise-all failures, stale display, or persistent loading behavior.

The candidate set supplies a mostly continuous normal route through login, project/task, upload, parsed database, business selection, generation, downloads, and logout, but lacks explicit progress/result handoff and several required observable data assertions.

The set covers an upload failure branch, file-selection/parsing recovery, downstream business generation, Excel download, and logout, but the same-task handoff and explicit error-clear/retry outcome are not proven.

critical_gaps: Required login validation, empty-data, locked-upload, parsed-data error, flow-text error, generation-progress/error, and result pagination/detail cases are missing.
Neither assembled E2E fully proves the required state handoffs, deterministic progress completion, matrix content, or session continuity; runtime-unverified feasibility remains a limitation.
The recovery E2E does not explicitly prove replacement of the invalid document in the same task after clearing the upload error.
